intent: Prevent scheduled pr-ci-health from force-rebasing any PR that changes a Session Entry packet; packet-bound branches must preserve their merge-base/digest identity until an owner-authorized append-only reseal.

negative_controls.command: python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import subprocess,sys; p=Path('scripts/governance/pr_ci_safe_rebase.py'); t=p.read_text(); old='PACKET_PREFIX = \"reports/agentops/work_packets/\"'; new='PACKET_PREFIX = \"reports/agentops/unprotected/\"'; assert old in t; p.write_text(t.replace(old,new,1)); r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'scripts/governance/pr_ci_safe_rebase.py','--selftest-packet-guard'],check=False); sys.exit(r.returncode)"
